Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SLOTTED RAISED COUNTERSUNK HEAD WOOD SCREWS 



1. Scope — Requirements for slotted raised countersunk head wood screws. 

2. Mafertal — Shall conform to the requirements laid down In IS : 451-1972 'Technical supply condl- 
tjons for wood screws {Stt^fidfmism) 

3. Dimensions and Tolerances 

3.1 The slotted raised countersunk head wood screws shall confomn to dimensions given In Table 1. 

2.2 The tolerances shall confonn to those given in Fig. 1 .

3.3 The preferred length, screw number combinations are given in Table 2. 

4. Designation — Wood screws shall be designated by the screw number ( screw designation ), length, 
number of this standard and material. 

Example: 

A slotted raised countersunk head wood screw No. 8, length 20 mm and made of steel 
shall be designated as: 

Wood Screw No. 8 x 20 IS : 6736 Steel 

5. General Requirements 

« i The wood screws shall be manufactured conforming to the fomr> and dimensions given in Fig. 1 and 

Tablll Thesc^^^^ to IS:45M972 in respect of requirements not covered in this 

standard. 

e. Finish — As given in IS : 451-1972. 

7. Packing - The wood screws shall be packed as given in IS : 451 -1972. 

a. Inspsction and Acceptance — As given In IS : 451-1972. 

t. Marking — As given in IS : 451 -1 972.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Wood screws were originally coverd in IS : 451 published in 1 961. Consequent on the revision 
of this standard, four separate standards are being published as follows: 

IS : 451-1972 Technical supply conditions for wood screws { Second rtvision) 
IS : 6736-1972 Specification for slotted raised countersunk head wood screws 
IS : 6739-1972 Specification for slotted round head wood screws 
IS ; 6760-1972 Specification for slotted countersunk head wood screws 

The sizes of wood screws Incorporated in the above standards are based on the size of wlr^ 
aauaes. Metric dimensions of these sizes are also given in the individual standards. The contractual 
SlauSs covered In The earlier version of the standard have since been deleted In the revved version. 



Reprography Unit. BIS. New Delhi. India
